final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT c.country AS country, AVG(cs.wins) AS aw FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(aw) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.country AS country, s1.aw AS aw, s1.aw - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.aw > s2.m), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(aw) AS m FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.country AS country, s3.aw AS aw, s3.d AS d, s3.aw - s4.m AS d2 FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.aw > s4.m) SELECT AVG(aw), AVG(d), AVG(d2) FROM s5
